original_test_intent: Verify the raw Type 4 Processor Characteristics bitmask for every populated processor advertises the project-approved SMBIOS-defined architectural capabilities, preserves reserved bits correctly and remains stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 4 records, retain the 16-bit characteristics mask per socket/handle, decode only bits defined for the applicable SMBIOS version, compare with the approved processor capability matrix, optionally correlate explicitly mapped architectural sources, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected mask/capability set, applicable SMBIOS definitions, any cross-source mappings and reboot plan. Read-only bitmask validation is automatable.
required_inputs: Applicable SMBIOS version and Processor Characteristics bit definitions
Expected raw/decoded capability set for each processor/socket
Policy for reserved, future and unknown bits and the `Unknown` characteristic
Approved mappings, if any, to CPUID/architectural or OS-visible feature sources
Validated raw parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and optional capability queries; do not enable CPU features, change BIOS settings, run feature activation workloads or modify firmware.
Preserve the raw 16-bit mask, formatted length and all defined/reserved bits; decoded labels alone are insufficient.
Do not equate capability bits automatically with a feature being enabled or exposed by the OS; cross-source comparison requires an explicit semantic mapping.
Decode only definitions valid for the reported SMBIOS version and retain unrecognized set bits for escalation.
Stop on reserved/unknown-bit policy violations, per-socket inconsistency, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw/decoded characteristics per Type 4 record, perform version-aware bit analysis, compare approved capability sets and persistence before/after reboot.
Do not change feature state, invent mappings from OS flags or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected characteristic masks/sets, SMBIOS-version definitions and reserved-bit policy.
Approve any architectural correlation and reboot/recovery, then issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep omits the raw mask and socket/formatted-length context and cannot prove version-correct reserved-bit decoding.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full raw/decoded Type 4 records, extract the exact characteristics mask per socket and decode against the applicable SMBIOS revision while retaining unknown bits.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Processor Characteristics scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat Processor Characteristics as a raw bitmask first, decode only SMBIOS-version-defined bits, compare per-socket capability sets with the approved CPU matrix and separately label any mapped CPUID/OS corroboration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 4 systems whose formatted length includes Processor Characteristics.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU SKU/architecture and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 Processor Characteristics bit definitions, processor architecture documentation and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw mask provenance, version gates, reserved-bit handling and capability-versus-enabled-state separation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; exposes unknown or incorrectly decoded bits that a label-only view can hide.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected capability mask/set and version policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Several SMBIOS characteristics are coarse architectural declarations and do not map one-to-one to OS feature flags or runtime enablement.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve an exact raw mask or a defined bit set by CPU SKU and SMBIOS revision; it must not require unrelated OS flags or clear future bits without an approved specification update.
expected_evidence: Approved SMBIOS-version definitions, per-socket expected mask/set, reserved/unknown policy and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 data with socket/handle, formatted length, raw mask and decoded defined/unknown bits
Any separately mapped architectural/OS corroboration with mapping rationale
Approved reboot/health evidence and identical post-reboot bit analysis
Engineer verdict with disposition for any unrecognized set bit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion consistently identify the characteristics field; expected capability policy is a required project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The raw mask is safely readable and reviewable once the applicable SMBIOS definitions and baseline are supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw mask, per-socket identity, version-aware decoding and reserved-bit retention.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps its correct bitmask framing while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE and limiting OS correlation to explicit mappings.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates processor capability declarations from runtime feature enablement and preserves unknown bits rather than guessing.

review_improvement: Prevents parser labels or OS feature lists from silently changing the meaning of a firmware capability bitmask.
independent_technical_reasoning: With approved versioned bit definitions and capability baseline, raw extraction, decoding, comparison and reboot persistence are deterministic software operations.
